meta.topic: What a passport office charges a citizen applying from the United States, where `content/passportsabroad.ts` took an estimate for it (brief 11's row KS-passport-fees): Iceland, Japan, Brazil and Latvia's fees, and New Zealand's GST and urgent fee
meta.method: Each page read on the issuer's own site (curl with a browser user agent, or WebFetch) and its text quoted; a fee settled only where read there. Search-engine summaries and secondary sites were used to find pages and are recorded as leads, never as the figure.
settled: Iceland: an Icelandic embassy charges the fee in Iceland, 19,000 ISK for an adult of 18 to 66 (USD 148 at December 2025's registered monthly rate), and sells express, 39,200 ISK in all (USD 306): the Ministry's consular fee schedule, under art. 14 of the Act on State Revenue Fees no. 88/1991. In the United States only the embassy in Washington takes applications, and Registers Iceland's four business days have the delivery added.

Brazil: a consulate charges 60 reais-ouro for a passaporte comum from 1 June 2026 (Portaria MRE nº 664 of 29 April 2026, item 110.5), a real-ouro being one US dollar (the Regulamento Consular Brasileiro, Portaria nº 428 of 15 December 2022, 4.1.45 IV): US$60.

Latvia: the embassy in the United States charges €140 for a passport alone, €115 under 20 or over 65, from 1 May 2026, and says an average of about eight weeks; it lists no urgent service, and ships by FedEx for €35.
notSettled: Japan: the dollar fee at the consulate for Connecticut from 1 July 2026. Every ny.us.emb-japan.go.jp and mofa.go.jp page answered 403 (Akamai, 'Access Denied') to curl and to WebFetch. Search extracts of the Boston and Anchorage consulates' own tables give US$62 at the window and US$60 online for a ten-year passport from 1 July 2026, and of New York's notice of 8 June 2026 that its dollar amount would follow; none of these is New York's figure read on its page.

New Zealand: whether a student in the United States is charged GST, and the urgent fee from overseas. passports.govt.nz answered a Cloudflare challenge (403) to curl and 503 to WebFetch; legislation.govt.nz and demo.legislation.govt.nz answered 202 with an empty body, three times each; the Internet Archive's captures of passports.govt.nz (1 October and 19 September 2026) reset every connection, and WebFetch refuses web.archive.org. DIA's own release confirms only the adult fee in force, $247 with GST from 2 May 2025.

brief12.topic: Brief 12's focused attempt at what brief 11 left blocked (row KS-passport-fees): Japan's fee at a consulate in the United States, and New Zealand's GST and urgent fee for an applicant abroad
brief12.method: As brief 11's: each figure read on its issuer's own site or in its own law, with curl and a browser user agent or WebFetch, and quoted; search summaries used only to find pages and recorded as leads. A value is 'unavailable' where no source publishes it, and 'blocked' where a source exists and access was refused or failed.
settled: Japan: US$62 for a ten-year passport applied for on paper at a Japanese embassy or consulate in the United States, US$60 online, from 1 July 2026 (MOFA Ordinance 4 of 2006, the ordinance on passport fees abroad, as amended by MOFA Ordinance 19 of 2026, promulgated 24 June 2026, in force 1 July 2026; read on e-Gov's law database). The fee is set for each country where the consular officer is posted, in its currency (the Passport Act's Enforcement Order, art. 5), so the consulate whose district holds Connecticut charges the same as any Japanese post in the United States. Applications made before 1 July 2026 keep the fees then in force (the amending ordinance's supplementary provision).
notSettled: New Zealand, GST: whether a New Zealander studying in New Haven pays GST on an online application. DIA's 2022 Cabinet papers say online applications from outside New Zealand don't attract GST; DIA's current costs page (blocked; seen in search extracts only) narrows it to 'a non-resident for New Zealand tax purposes', which IRD's test decides by a permanent place of abode in New Zealand and 325 days away. That is the applicant's own facts, which SLATE doesn't hold and no source can publish for its student: unavailable. SLATE's assumption: charged (`NZ_FROM_ABROAD.gstCharged`).

New Zealand, urgent fee from overseas: the 2025 regulations (SL 2025/75) are blocked (an AWS WAF challenge); DIA's 2022 schedule set the priority fee for an application lodged in New Zealand or online equal to the standard fee, and Cabinet's 2025 increase of about 14.9% applied to passport and travel document fees alike. SLATE's assumption: the standard fee, NZ$214.78 before GST (`NZ_FROM_ABROAD.urgentBeforeGst`).
